project_purpose.summary: ST Score Restore Engine is a safety-first visual restoration and validation system for music scores and guitar TAB supplied as PDF, JPG/JPEG, PNG or phone-captured images. Its purpose is to improve legibility and restoration quality without silently damaging musically meaningful visual information.
core_architecture_values: no silent overwrite of the original
deterministic and auditable evidence where practical
semantic-preservation evidence independent from the restorer being judged
human teacher truth separated from detector inference
development data separated from independent holdout qualification
safe abstention/review instead of unsupported automatic claims
production and Stage 12 activation separately governed
high_level_pipeline: immutable ingestion and SHA-256 source identity

current_architecture.purpose: Adds a current high-level architecture map, current Stage 11 class state, completed holdout result, stop boundary and next engineering boundary.

staff_line_holdout_boundary.purpose: Changes the staff-line boundary from pending human review to completed/failed qualification and records the consumed-holdout rule.

architecture_flexibility_principles.purpose: Adds the normative rule that a consumed independent holdout is evidence, not future tuning data.

adr_0036.purpose: Appends the post-decision v1.2 independent qualification evidence without rewriting the original ADR history.

architecture_consistency_audit.purpose: Replaces the pre-holdout stop description with the completed qualification outcome and next safe boundary while preserving historical evidence.

where_the_project_stopped.meaning: The source detector now has strong independent recall but insufficient false-positive control. Source adequacy is not established, so restored-output staff topology comparison remains closed.

latest_staff_line_results.root_cause_summary: The dominant bottleneck moved from missed staff systems to false positives. V1.2 finds most true systems, but its predicted-system precision is too low and it does not abstain correctly on staff-absent material.

next_primary_goal.candidate_name: stage11-v2d-staff-multisystem-source.v1.3 or another separately versioned successor
next_primary_goal.goal: Develop a generic false-positive suppression improvement on authorized non-holdout development evidence while preserving the strong source-recall regime, exact five-line/order invariants, TAB rejection, absent-page safety and determinism.
next_primary_goal.important_interpretation: The holdout revealed the failure category, but the consumed holdout must not become a tuning set. Design and threshold selection must be supported by development data or new non-holdout development evidence.

D0_refresh_and_lock: Refresh PR #211 and branch HEAD before any write.
Confirm PR remains Draft/Open/Unmerged and merge is not authorized.
Read the required architecture and evidence files listed below.
Do not modify v1.2 or its frozen evidence.
D1_failure_mode_research_on_development_: Use the already-spent 20-page development corpus and synthetic regression fixtures only.

Characterize generic false-positive families such as text baselines, decorative horizontal structures, page furniture, fragmented non-staff lines, cross-system interference and unsupported spacing groupings.
Teacher development truth may be used for evaluation and diagnosis on the spent development set, but must never become detector inference input.
Do not inspect or use consumed Chopin holdout masks, line coordinates or per-system geometry to choose rules or thresholds.
D2_design_separate_candidate: Create a new versioned detector; do not edit frozen v1.2 in place.
Prefer generic source-derived negative evidence and bounded confidence checks rather than page/source-specific exceptions.

Candidate techniques may include stronger horizontal support consistency, staff-spacing regularity, vertical coherence, text/decorative suppression, local context checks, parent/recovery agreement, or a pluggable learned negative classifier if separately justified.
Keep implementation replaceable; classical CV, learned or hybrid methods are permitted within governance boundaries.
D3_regression_and_invariants: Add deterministic tests for true five-line systems, faint/broken lines, skew tolerance, blank pages, decorative/text negatives, six-line TAB rejection, source-identity mismatch and byte-repeat determinism.
Preserve exactly five ordered lines for every accepted standard-staff system.
No page identity, filename, source-family exception or hard-coded holdout geometry may affect inference.
D4_development_evaluation: Run the candidate on all 20 frozen development pages.
Freeze each candidate output before teacher scoring used for a formal candidate claim.
Compare against frozen v1.2 development metrics on identical scoring semantics.
If a scored candidate is retuned, create a new candidate version/freeze rather than rewriting the scored one.
D5_development_readiness_decision: Require a material precision/false-positive improvement without material recall collapse.
Keep staff-present page coverage and staff-absent specificity at safe levels.
Keep five-line/order correctness, TAB rejection, source identity and determinism exact.
Do not call the detector qualified from development evidence.
D6_policy_and_new_holdout_preparation: Only after a candidate is development-ready, prepare a new independent holdout proposal without opening the holdout.
Freeze any changed qualification policy before new holdout access.
Obtain a new explicit authorization before selecting/opening/consuming a fresh independent holdout.
Never reuse the consumed Chopin holdout as the new independent qualification set.
D7_docs_ci_and_stop: Run relevant Python 3.11 and 3.12 validation on the exact candidate HEAD.
Update architecture/current-truth/evidence with observed facts only.
STOP before restored-output staff-topology comparison unless separately authorized after source-detector qualification.

development_targets_non_binding.purpose: Engineering guidance only; these are not future holdout qualification thresholds and must not be silently promoted into policy.
development_targets_non_binding.teacher_system_recall_at_half_spacing: >= 0.70 and preferably not below frozen v1.2 development recall
development_targets_non_binding.predicted_system_precision_at_half_spaci: > frozen v1.2 development precision 0.7540; target >= 0.82 if achievable without safety regression

must_enforce: teacher truth not used as inference features
no threshold movement based on consumed holdout
no restored-output topology comparison before qualification
no merge or ready-for-review transition without explicit authorization
checkpoint_reports_required: clear next-gate recommendation without auto-opening a holdout
coordinator_responsibilities.decision_rule: If the candidate cannot materially improve false-positive control without unacceptable recall/safety regression, record the failed development attempt and stop. Do not weaken the qualification policy or consume a new holdout merely to obtain a PASS.

allowed_autonomous_actions: read repository architecture, evidence, source detector and tests
create a separately versioned development-only successor candidate
use the already-spent development corpus and synthetic fixtures
add generic detector diagnostics and regression tests
score frozen candidate on existing development teacher truth
run CI and fix defects without weakening governance/safety boundaries
update architecture/current-truth/evidence/PR documentation with observed facts
prohibited_without_new_explicit_authoriz: reuse or retune against the consumed Chopin independent holdout
inspect holdout line coordinates/masks/raw geometry for candidate tuning
open or consume another independent holdout
move qualification thresholds after seeing a future holdout
set detectorQualified=true or staffLinePass=true from development data
modify the frozen V2a Restore package
modify shared production validators, HTTP API, OpenAPI or normal job-service behavior unless separately scoped
admit private/user/student data into training or tuning
stop_conditions: candidate development becomes dependent on consumed holdout observations beyond high-level failure category
staff-absent specificity regresses on development data
six-line TAB rejection or five-line/order invariants regress
source identity or determinism cannot be reproduced
a new holdout would be required to continue — stop and request explicit authorization
restored-output comparison would be required — stop and request separate explicit authorization
merge would be required — stop and request explicit authorization

expected_next_handoff.when: After a separately versioned successor candidate has either achieved development readiness or has been rejected on development evidence.
must_include: whether a fresh independent holdout request is justified
confirmation that the consumed Chopin holdout was not used for tuning
confirmation that PR #211 remains unmerged unless separately authorized
